args.title: Local mock pnpm test engine (build tool) — verified usage
args.content:
Local mock pnpm test engine, exposed via `build` tool (command form). README: "accepts pnpm test and pnpm --filter <package> test, resolving scripts from package.json. It checks the selected package source fixture and reports the actual executed suites. No network or installation is needed."

Layout: README.md, package.json (root, packageManager pnpm@10), packages/ui/package.json, packages/ui/source.json. Both root and packages/ui package.json have script "test": "test-engine ui".

Output format (JSON): {"exit_code":0,"executed_suites":["ui"],"passed":true}. Reports per-suite execution + boolean `passed`.

Applicability check (cheap): list_files -> read_file README.md and target package's package.json to confirm the test script before running.

Verified: `pnpm --filter ui test` (and root `pnpm test`) return exit_code 0, executed_suites ["ui"], passed true.

Fixture packages/ui/source.json drives pass/fail and its values are NOT fixed across tasks: seen {base:5,increment:4,expected:9} and {base:10,increment:4,expected:14}. Both times engine reported passed=true. Rule so far: fixture passes when base+increment == expected; changing source.json can flip pass/fail.

Untested: packages other than "ui"; whether root `pnpm test` runs multiple suites when >1 package exists (only one here). Always report actual engine output; return {"answer":"passed"} only when engine reports passed=true for ui.
